Do not return source hashes; host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"book": "Adventures of Huckleberry Finn", "chapter": "CHAPTER XIII.", "unit": 16, "previous_english": ["Then Jim manned the oars, and we took out after our raft. Now was the first time that I begun to worry about the men—I reckon I hadn’t had time to before. I begun to think how dreadful it was, even for murderers, to be in such a fix. I says to myself, there ain’t no telling but I might come to be a murderer myself yet, and then how would I like it? So says I to Jim:", "“The first light we see we’ll land a hundred yards below it or above it, in a place where it’s a good hiding-place for you and the skiff, and then I’ll go and fix up some kind of a yarn, and get somebody to go for that gang and get them out of their scrape, so they can be hung when their time comes.”", "But that idea was a failure; for pretty soon it begun to storm again, and this time worse than ever. The rain poured down, and never a light showed; everybody in bed, I reckon. We boomed along down the river, watching for lights and watching for our raft. After a long time the rain let up, but the clouds stayed, and the lightning kept whimpering, and by-and-by a flash showed us a black thing ahead, floating, and we made for it."], "previous_reviewed_russian": ["Потом Джим сел на вёсла, и мы пустились вдогонку за нашим плотом. Вот тогда я впервые и стал тревожиться за тех людей — наверное, раньше у меня на это времени не было. Я стал думать, как это ужасно, даже для убийц, попасть в такую переделку. Говорю себе: кто знает, может, я и сам когда-нибудь стану убийцей, и каково мне тогда будет? И говорю я Джиму:", "— Как увидим первый огонёк, пристанем ярдов на сто ниже него или выше, в таком месте, где можно хорошо спрятать тебя и лодку, а потом я пойду, сочиню какую-нибудь историю и найду кого-нибудь, кто пошёл бы за этой шайкой и вытащил их из беды, чтобы их могли повесить, когда придёт их срок.", "Но затея не удалась: скоро опять разразилась гроза, и на этот раз хуже прежнего. Дождь лил как из ведра, и ни один огонёк не показывался; все, наверное, спали. Мы мчались вниз по реке, высматривая огни и высматривая наш плот. Спустя долгое время дождь унялся, но тучи остались, и молния всё поскуливала, а потом вспышка показала нам впереди плывущую по воде чёрную громаду, и мы направились к ней."]}, "source_rows": [{"id": "043-016-0020", "tag": "p", "text": "It was the raft, and mighty glad was we to get aboard of it again. We seen a light now away down to the right, on shore. So I said I would go for it. The skiff was half full of plunder which that gang had stole there on the wreck. We hustled it on to the raft in a pile, and I told Jim to float along down, and show a light when he judged he had gone about two mile, and keep it burning till I come; then I manned my oars and shoved for the light. As I got down towards it, three or four more showed—up on a hillside. It was a village. I closed in above the shore light, and laid on my oars and floated. As I went by, I see it was a lantern hanging on the jackstaff of a double-hull ferry-boat. I skimmed around for the watchman, a-wondering whereabouts he slept; and by-and-by I found him roosting on the bitts, forward, with his head down between his knees. I gave his shoulder two or three little shoves, and begun to cry.", "sha256": "f26f2d115e5f3e8b071ed1fd705244095402e3f42e641ed656332e6ddb4fb7a9", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[20]", "source_html": "It was the raft, and mighty glad was we to get aboard of it again. We seen a light now away down to the right, on shore. So I said I would go for it. The skiff was half full of plunder which that gang had stole there on the wreck. We hustled it on to the raft in a pile, and I told Jim to float along down, and show a light when he judged he had gone about two mile, and keep it burning till I come; then I manned my oars and shoved for the light. As I got down towards it, three or four more showed—up on a hillside. It was a village. I closed in above the shore light, and laid on my oars and floated. I skimmed around for the watchman, a-wondering whereabouts he slept; and by-and-by I found him roosting on the bitts, forward, with his head down between his knees. I gave his shoulder two or three little shoves, and begun to cry."}, {"id": "043-016-0021", "tag": "p", "text": "He stirred up, in a kind of a startlish way; but when he see it was only me, he took a good gap and stretch, and then he says:", "sha256": "24fd2565e6a12e50c11e6bf04ec37dd4b43706b636234cd104c1fa68337d2093", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[21]", "source_html": "He stirred up, in a kind of a startlish way; but when he see it was only me, he took a good gap and stretch, and then he says:"}, {"id": "043-016-0022", "tag": "p", "text": "“Hello, what’s up? Don’t cry, bub. What’s the trouble?”", "sha256": "35b308be11b37b312fab36ebdc732fe441fbdab13f1dc5ce1773351e239b1e32", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[22]", "source_html": "“Hello, what’s up? Don’t cry, bub. What’s the trouble?”"}, {"id": "043-016-0023", "tag": "source_caption", "text": "“Hello, What’s Up?”", "sha256": "46279d2e01c6dd6232c749948ed60ea545b5cd6e38aa9bf8f1aff6de5399109a", "source_location": "illustration-index/#c13-104", "image_id": "c13-104"}, {"id": "043-016-0024", "tag": "p", "text": "I says:", "sha256": "0e568af30022d4c6b08be6c92743d85cbf120134610018b892e098e0fe72f7eb", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[24]", "source_html": "I says:"}, {"id": "043-016-0025", "tag": "p", "text": "“Pap, and mam, and sis, and—”", "sha256": "4841307e71f3bc5a48835a2964a0a7c8ac555f0ce5cb9b2861b012208559fe60", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[25]", "source_html": "“Pap, and mam, and sis, and—”"}, {"id": "043-016-0026", "tag": "p", "text": "Then I broke down. He says:", "sha256": "0ae01a9fd8f5c7352523ac8327346b820713f18c98b39b4166f21461c9207585", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[26]", "source_html": "Then I broke down. He says:"}, {"id": "043-016-0027", "tag": "p", "text": "“Oh, dang it now, don’t take on so; we all has to have our troubles, and this’n ’ll come out all right. What’s the matter with ’em?”", "sha256": "c4defb650818e35eda2f6a1df5b4d457d6f416f5d34db2dc4a5eab0f0267272a", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[27]", "source_html": "“Oh, dang it now, don’t take on so; we all has to have our troubles, and this’n ’ll come out all right. What’s the matter with ’em?”"}, {"id": "043-016-0028", "tag": "p", "text": "“They’re—they’re—are you the watchman of the boat?”", "sha256": "3d3819bd1f4c67d3bf62109a7883d965a439a081c25ae3026c47550d0dbdb838", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[28]", "source_html": "“They’re—they’re—are you the watchman of the boat?”"}, {"id": "043-016-0029", "tag": "p", "text": "“Yes,” he says, kind of pretty-well-satisfied like. “I’m the captain and the owner and the mate and the pilot and watchman and head deck-hand; and sometimes I’m the freight and passengers. I ain’t as rich as old Jim Hornback, and I can’t be so blame’ generous and good to Tom, Dick and Harry as what he is, and slam around money the way he does; but I’ve told him a many a time ’t I wouldn’t trade places with him; for, says I, a sailor’s life’s the life for me, and I’m derned if I’d live two mile out o’ town, where there ain’t nothing ever goin’ on, not for all his spondulicks and as much more on top of it. Says I—”", "sha256": "e5ca9bc6f4a9511f3aaea697488f6df7680e4834fbe1dc15cb7ed2f1a747b482", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[29]", "source_html": "“Yes,” he says, kind of pretty-well-satisfied like. “I’m the captain and the owner and the mate and the pilot and watchman and head deck-hand; and sometimes I’m the freight and passengers. I ain’t as rich as old Jim Hornback, and I can’t be so blame’ generous and good to Tom, Dick and Harry as what he is, and slam around money the way he does; but I’ve told him a many a time ’t I wouldn’t trade places with him; for, says I, a sailor’s life’s the life for me, and I’m derned if I’d live two mile out o’ town, where there ain’t nothing ever goin’ on, not for all his spondulicks and as much more on top of it. Says I—”"}, {"id": "043-016-0030", "tag": "p", "text": "I broke in and says:", "sha256": "558272400d99510cbb8e15bd3b2848ff8f2368be959f13ec2023223e1d3862bf", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[30]", "source_html": "I broke in and says:"}, {"id": "043-016-0031", "tag": "p", "text": "“They’re in an awful peck of trouble, and—”", "sha256": "297ba6e73577b10aff7ce75814e78091bcb3189a9ee098ff388349f6caefc2a6", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[31]", "source_html": "“They’re in an awful peck of trouble, and—”"}, {"id": "043-016-0032", "tag": "p", "text": "“Who is?”", "sha256": "4f5799cfde0c0451c2b6cadd1de9240a0fa76c28c24fe17a4cf3be231d8c01a8", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[32]", "source_html": "“Who is?”"}, {"id": "043-016-0033", "tag": "p", "text": "“Why, pap and mam and sis and Miss Hooker; and if you’d take your ferry-boat and go up there—”", "sha256": "a74bf191c1aab8c1296c2f0ac7001a70bc6043b97c62beb9d92c9921171bfcaf", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[33]", "source_html": "“Why, pap and mam and sis and Miss Hooker; and if you’d take your ferry-boat and go up there—”"}, {"id": "043-016-0034", "tag": "p", "text": "“Up where? Where are they?”", "sha256": "86b80446e2f131be5e419fddb7c9b8ac38aaf7e04e9ec680c48691af091424f1", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[34]", "source_html": "“Up where? Where are they?”"}, {"id": "043-016-0035", "tag": "p", "text": "“On the wreck.”", "sha256": "5c7fa2821096ea2590851df60a3fd31de7485eaa8379df0c3de1bf9f94010763", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[35]", "source_html": "“On the wreck.”"}, {"id": "043-016-0036", "tag": "p", "text": "“What wreck?”", "sha256": "0ed198d4d2e33234d202e2d375f8f8f716a3dbba602866c314dd50777870105d", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[36]", "source_html": "“What wreck?”"}, {"id": "043-016-0037", "tag": "p", "text": "“Why, there ain’t but one.”", "sha256": "9998514d454dd2bcf2ce02083aafe8548168f73169e770b3d9282432df345c95", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[37]", "source_html": "“Why, there ain’t but one.”"}, {"id": "043-016-0038", "tag": "p", "text": "“What, you don’t mean the Walter Scott?”", "sha256": "f162219beb991f876ab63355fbd7659437e8a3e13ba1a5c551d29645376b0448", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[38]", "source_html": "“What, you don’t mean the Walter Scott?”"}, {"id": "043-016-0039", "tag": "p", "text": "“Yes.”", "sha256": "838a04296799794f4e1a85c40540fd52027a3aa3d6a1cd735f69b489839212cf", "source_location": "div.chapter[18]/*[39]", "source_html": "“Yes.”"}], "draft_rows": [{"source_id": "043-016-0020", "target": "Это был плот, и мы были безмерно рады снова оказаться на его борту. Теперь мы увидели свет далеко внизу справа, на берегу. Тогда я сказал, что пойду туда. Шлюпка была наполовину загружена добычей, которую эта банда украла там, на месте кораблекрушения. Мы быстро свалили всё это на плот в одну кучу, и я велел Джиму плыть вниз по течению, зажечь свет, когда он сочтёт, что проплыл около двух миль, и держать его зажженным, пока я не вернусь; затем я взялся за весла и поплыл к свету. Когда я приблизился к нему, появились ещё три или четыре огня — на склоне холма. Это была деревня. Я подошёл ближе к береговому огню, опустил весла и поплыл по течению. Проплывая мимо, я увидел, что это был фонарь, висевший на флагштоке парома с двойным корпусом. Я обплыл вокруг в поисках сторожа, гадая, где же он спит; и вскоре обнаружил его, прижавшегося к причальным кнехтам в носовой части, с головой, опущенной между колен. Я два-три раза слегка толкнул его в плечо и начал кричать.", "source_sha256": "f26f2d115e5f3e8b071ed1fd705244095402e3f42e641ed656332e6ddb4fb7a9", "target_id": "ru-043-016-0020", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "1092cdbc7f1d193f26ab29af83396c6206d44ec5b3d39f4dc7ca5dfb4f4a1cb0"}, {"source_id": "043-016-0021", "target": "Он вздрогнул, как будто от чего-то испугавшись; но когда увидел, что это только я, он хорошенько потянулся и потянулся, а потом говорит:", "source_sha256": "24fd2565e6a12e50c11e6bf04ec37dd4b43706b636234cd104c1fa68337d2093", "target_id": "ru-043-016-0021", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "fa8ced9f8cd79e14e62d01dd96083b759a9d38fb5d6d98339eaaca666b2ee2f1"}, {"source_id": "043-016-0022", "target": "«Привет, как дела? Не плачь, приятель. В чём дело?»", "source_sha256": "35b308be11b37b312fab36ebdc732fe441fbdab13f1dc5ce1773351e239b1e32", "target_id": "ru-043-016-0022", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "98718e2d57ed420149b893c94ea1c361f54c1b92036a00c7b275e0460887c407"}, {"source_id": "043-016-0023", "target": "«Привет, как дела?»", "source_sha256": "46279d2e01c6dd6232c749948ed60ea545b5cd6e38aa9bf8f1aff6de5399109a", "target_id": "ru-043-016-0023", "tag": "source_caption", "target_sha256": "f2b5ed690cbea8596399df4668ddabafe60b500cd6a773bc74e8db16eb25682b"}, {"source_id": "043-016-0024", "target": "Я говорю:", "source_sha256": "0e568af30022d4c6b08be6c92743d85cbf120134610018b892e098e0fe72f7eb", "target_id": "ru-043-016-0024", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "fa163bba54dc6558fc348978f79413775cd345d5e175c50769a5d6e4566f034e"}, {"source_id": "043-016-0025", "target": "«Папа, мама, сестра и…»", "source_sha256": "4841307e71f3bc5a48835a2964a0a7c8ac555f0ce5cb9b2861b012208559fe60", "target_id": "ru-043-016-0025", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "bb7255a21b734fe3e9f765fff6df57199a12ede463ab33d8fdc13a99bf7a753d"}, {"source_id": "043-016-0026", "target": "Тогда я не выдержал. Он говорит:", "source_sha256": "0ae01a9fd8f5c7352523ac8327346b820713f18c98b39b4166f21461c9207585", "target_id": "ru-043-016-0026", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "3bf7b6be351a28f5fc4efff06692bb2568fbcdfc9b173b964a46c9ab17ba3c31"}, {"source_id": "043-016-0027", "target": "«Ой, черт возьми, не переживай так; у всех нас бывают свои проблемы, и всё это закончится хорошо. Что с ними такое?»", "source_sha256": "c4defb650818e35eda2f6a1df5b4d457d6f416f5d34db2dc4a5eab0f0267272a", "target_id": "ru-043-016-0027", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "a5a410adb932a1eb1ab82b54439c7e0eb5efde9496b911f89b0995956d065586"}, {"source_id": "043-016-0028", "target": "«Это… это… вы — сторож лодки?»", "source_sha256": "3d3819bd1f4c67d3bf62109a7883d965a439a081c25ae3026c47550d0dbdb838", "target_id": "ru-043-016-0028", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "0a634e9a36408c7e3fc41b3164b139599b14c688a58a3164453f1d39263ac9a1"}, {"source_id": "043-016-0029", "target": "«Да», — говорит он, выглядя довольно-таки довольным. «Я и капитан, и владелец, и помощник капитана, и лоцман, и вахтенный, и старший матрос; а иногда я ещё и груз, и пассажиры. Я не так богат, как старик Джим Хорнбэк, и не могу быть таким чертовски щедрым и добрым к Томам, Дикам и Гарри, как он, и разбрасываться деньгами так, как он; но я ему много раз говорил, что не променял бы с ним места; потому что, говорю я, жизнь моряка — это жизнь для меня, и будь я проклят, если бы жил в двух милях от города, где никогда ничего не происходит, даже за все его бабки и ещё столько же сверху.
